verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֮ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְיָשֻׁ֗בוּ וְיַחֲנוּ֙ לִפְנֵי֙ פִּ֣י הַחִירֹ֔ת בֵּ֥ין מִגְדֹּ֖ל וּבֵ֣ין הַיָּ֑ם לִפְנֵי֙ בַּ֣עַל צְפֹ֔ן נִכְח֥וֹ תַחֲנ֖וּ עַל־ הַיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·yā·šu·ḇū wə·ya·ḥă·nū lip̄·nê pî ha·ḥî·rōṯ bên miḡ·dōl ū·ḇên hay·yām lip̄·nê ba·‘al ṣə·p̄ōn niḵ·ḥōw ṯa·ḥă·nū ‘al- hay·yām
verses.literal: Tell the Israelites . . . to turn back and encamp before Pi-hahiroth between Migdol . . . and the sea You are to encamp by the sea directly opposite Baal-zephon . . .
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel que retrocedam e se acampem em frente de Pi-Hairote, entre Migdol e o mar, diante de Baal-Zefom; defronte dele, assentareis o campo junto ao mar.

verses.original: וְאָמַ֤ר פַּרְעֹה֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְבֻכִ֥ים הֵ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ סָגַ֥ר עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar par·‘ōh liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl nə·ḇu·ḵîm hêm bā·’ā·reṣ sā·ḡar ‘ă·lê·hem ham·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: For Pharaoh will say of the Israelites They are wandering the land in confusion the wilderness has boxed them in
verses.literalPt: Faraó dirá dos filhos de Israel: Eles estão embaraçados na terra, o deserto os encerrou.

verses.original: וְחִזַּקְתִּ֣י אֶת־ לֵב־ פַּרְעֹה֮ וְרָדַ֣ף אַחֲרֵיהֶם֒ וְאִכָּבְדָ֤ה בְּפַרְעֹה֙ וּבְכָל־ חֵיל֔וֹ וְיָדְע֥וּ מִצְרַ֖יִם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־ כֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥiz·zaq·tî ’eṯ- lêḇ- par·‘ōh wə·rā·ḏap̄ ’a·ḥă·rê·hem wə·’ik·kā·ḇə·ḏāh bə·p̄ar·‘ōh ū·ḇə·ḵāl ḥê·lōw wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū miṣ·ra·yim kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh way·ya·‘ă·śū- ḵên
verses.literal: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart so that he will pursue them But I will gain honor by means of Pharaoh and all his army and the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD So this is what the Israelites did
verses.literalPt: Endurecerei o coração de Faraó, e ele os perseguirá; glorificar-me-ei em Faraó e em todo o seu exército; e os egípcios saberão que eu sou Jeová. Eles assim o fizeram.

verses.original: וַיֻּגַּד֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֥י בָרַ֖ח הָעָ֑ם וַ֠יֵּהָפֵךְ לְבַ֨ב פַּרְעֹ֤ה וַעֲבָדָיו֙ אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם וַיֹּֽאמרוּ֙ מַה־ זֹּ֣את עָשִׂ֔ינוּ כִּֽי־ שִׁלַּ֥חְנוּ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵעָבְדֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yug·gaḏ lə·me·leḵ miṣ·ra·yim kî ḇā·raḥ hā·‘ām way·yê·hā·p̄êḵ lə·ḇaḇ par·‘ōh wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ’el- hā·‘ām way·yō·m·rū mah- zōṯ ‘ā·śî·nū kî- šil·laḥ·nū ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl mê·‘ā·ḇə·ḏê·nū
verses.literal: When the king of Egypt was told that the people had fled Pharaoh and his officials changed their minds about them and said What . . . have we done . . . We have released Israel from serving us
verses.literalPt: Foi dito ao rei dos egípcios que o povo havia fugido; mudou-se o coração de Faraó e dos seus servos para com o povo, e disseram: Que é isso que fizemos, permitindo que Israel nos deixasse de servir?

verses.original: וַיֶּאְסֹ֖ר אֶת־ רִכְבּ֑וֹ וְאֶת־ עַמּ֖וֹ לָקַ֥ח עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye’·sōr ’eṯ- riḵ·bōw wə·’eṯ- ‘am·mōw lā·qaḥ ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: So Pharaoh prepared his chariot and took his army with him
verses.literalPt: Faraó mandou aprontar o seu carro e tomou consigo o seu povo;

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֗ח שֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת רֶ֙כֶב֙ בָּח֔וּר וְכֹ֖ל רֶ֣כֶב מִצְרָ֑יִם וְשָׁלִשִׁ֖ם עַל־ כֻּלּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ šêš- mê·’ō·wṯ re·ḵeḇ bā·ḥūr wə·ḵōl re·ḵeḇ miṣ·rā·yim wə·šā·li·šim ‘al- kul·lōw
verses.literal: He took 600 . . . of the best chariots and all the other chariots of Egypt with officers over all of them
verses.literalPt: também tomou seiscentos carros escolhidos e todos os carros do Egito, com capitães sobre todos eles.

verses.original: וַיְחַזֵּ֣ק יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶת־ לֵ֤ב פַּרְעֹה֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּרְדֹּ֕ף אַחֲרֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יֹצְאִ֖ים בְּיָ֥ד רָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥaz·zêq Yah·weh ’eṯ- lêḇ par·‘ōh me·leḵ miṣ·ra·yim way·yir·dōp̄ ’a·ḥă·rê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl yō·ṣə·’îm bə·yāḏ rā·māh
verses.literal: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt so that he pursued . . . the Israelites . . . - who were marching out defiantly . . .
verses.literalPt: Jeová endureceu o coração de Faraó, rei do Egito, e este perseguiu os filhos de Israel; pois os filhos de Israel saíram afoitamente.

verses.original: וַיִּרְדְּפ֨וּ מִצְרַ֜יִם אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם וַיַּשִּׂ֤יגוּ אוֹתָם֙ חֹנִ֣ים עַל־ הַיָּ֔ם כָּל־ סוּס֙ רֶ֣כֶב פַּרְעֹ֔ה וּפָרָשָׁ֖יו וְחֵיל֑וֹ עַל־ פִּי֙ הַֽחִירֹ֔ת לִפְנֵ֖י בַּ֥עַל צְפֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·də·p̄ū miṣ·ra·yim ’a·ḥă·rê·hem way·yaś·śî·ḡū ’ō·w·ṯām ḥō·nîm ‘al- hay·yām kāl- sūs re·ḵeḇ par·‘ōh ū·p̄ā·rā·šāw wə·ḥê·lōw ‘al- pî ha·ḥî·rōṯ lip̄·nê ba·‘al ṣə·p̄ōn
verses.literal: The Egyptians all Pharaoh’s horses and chariots horsemen and troops pursued the Israelites and overtook them as they camped by the sea near Pi-hahiroth opposite Baal-zephon
verses.literalPt: Perseguiam-nos os egípcios, a saber, todos os cavalos e carros de Faraó, e os seus cavaleiros, e o seu exército, e alcançaram-nos acampados junto ao mar, perto de Pi-Hairote, defronte de Baal-Zefom.

verses.original: וּפַרְעֹ֖ה הִקְרִ֑יב וַיִּשְׂאוּ֩ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל אֶת־ עֵינֵיהֶ֜ם וְהִנֵּ֥ה מִצְרַ֣יִם׀ נֹסֵ֣עַ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם וַיִּֽירְאוּ֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַיִּצְעֲק֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ar·‘ōh hiq·rîḇ way·yiś·’ū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- ‘ê·nê·hem wə·hin·nêh miṣ·ra·yim nō·sê·a‘ ’a·ḥă·rê·hem way·yî·rə·’ū mə·’ōḏ way·yiṣ·‘ă·qū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’el- Yah·weh
verses.literal: As Pharaoh approached the Israelites . . . looked up . . . and saw the Egyptians marching after them and they . . . were terrified . . . and cried out to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Quando Faraó se chegou perto, levantaram os olhos os filhos de Israel, e eis que os egípcios marchavam atrás deles; os filhos de Israel tiveram muito medo e clamaram a Jeová.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֮ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֒ הַֽמִבְּלִ֤י אֵין־ קְבָרִים֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם לְקַחְתָּ֖נוּ לָמ֣וּת בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר מַה־ זֹּאת֙ עָשִׂ֣יתָ לָּ֔נוּ לְהוֹצִיאָ֖נוּ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’el- mō·šeh ha·mib·bə·lî ’ên- qə·ḇā·rîm bə·miṣ·ra·yim lə·qaḥ·tā·nū lā·mūṯ bam·miḏ·bār mah- zōṯ ‘ā·śî·ṯā lā·nū lə·hō·w·ṣî·’ā·nū mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: They said to Moses Was it because there were no graves in Egypt that you brought us into the wilderness to die What . . . have you done to us by bringing us out of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Disseram a Moisés: Foi porque não havia sepulcros no Egito que nos tiraste para morrermos no deserto? Por que motivo nos trataste assim, fazendo-nos sair do Egito?

verses.original: הֲלֹא־ זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבַּ֨רְנוּ אֵלֶ֤יךָ בְמִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר חֲדַ֥ל מִמֶּ֖נּוּ וְנַֽעַבְדָ֣ה אֶת־ מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּ֣י ט֥וֹב לָ֙נוּ֙ עֲבֹ֣ד אֶת־ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִמֻּתֵ֖נוּ בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- zeh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer dib·bar·nū ’ê·le·ḵā ḇə·miṣ·ra·yim lê·mōr ḥă·ḏal mim·men·nū wə·na·‘aḇ·ḏāh ’eṯ- miṣ·rā·yim kî ṭō·wḇ lā·nū ‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- miṣ·ra·yim mim·mu·ṯê·nū bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: Did we not - say to you in Egypt . . . Leave us alone . . . so that we may serve the Egyptians For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Não é isto mesmo o que te dissemos no Egito: deixa-nos, para que sirvamos aos egípcios? Pois melhor nos fora servir aos egípcios do que morrermos no deserto.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶל־ הָעָם֮ אַל־ תִּירָאוּ֒ הִֽתְיַצְב֗וּ וּרְאוּ֙ אֶת־ יְשׁוּעַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם כִּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר רְאִיתֶ֤ם אֶת־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ הַיּ֔וֹם לֹ֥א תֹסִ֛יפוּ לִרְאֹתָ֥ם ע֖וֹד עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- hā·‘ām ’al- tî·rā·’ū hiṯ·yaṣ·ḇū ū·rə·’ū ’eṯ- yə·šū·‘aṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer- ya·‘ă·śeh lā·ḵem hay·yō·wm kî ’ă·šer rə·’î·ṯem ’eṯ- miṣ·ra·yim hay·yō·wm lō ṯō·sî·p̄ū lir·’ō·ṯām ‘ō·wḏ ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: But Moses told . . . the people Do not be afraid Stand firm and you will see the LORD’s salvation which He will accomplish for you today for the Egyptians you see today - . . . you will never . . . . . . see again . . .
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Moisés ao povo: Não temais, estai quietos e vede o livramento que Jeová vos há de dar hoje; porque os egípcios que vedes hoje, nunca jamais os tornareis a ver.

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה יִלָּחֵ֣ם לָכֶ֑ם וְאַתֶּ֖ם תַּחֲרִישֽׁוּן׃פ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yil·lā·ḥêm lā·ḵem wə·’at·tem ta·ḥă·rî·šūn
verses.literal: The LORD will fight for you you need only to be still
verses.literalPt: Jeová pelejará por vós, e vós vos calareis.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה מַה־ תִּצְעַ֖ק אֵלָ֑י דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְיִסָּֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh mah- tiṣ·‘aq ’ê·lāy dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl wə·yis·sā·‘ū
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Why are you crying out to Me Tell . . . the Israelites . . . to go forward
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Por que clamas a mim? Fala aos filhos de Israel que marchem.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה הָרֵ֣ם אֶֽת־ מַטְּךָ֗ וּנְטֵ֧ה אֶת־ יָדְךָ֛ עַל־ הַיָּ֖ם וּבְקָעֵ֑הוּ וְיָבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיָּ֖ם בַּיַּבָּשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh hā·rêm ’eṯ- maṭ·ṭə·ḵā ū·nə·ṭêh ’eṯ- yā·ḏə·ḵā ‘al- hay·yām ū·ḇə·qā·‘ê·hū wə·yā·ḇō·’ū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·ṯō·wḵ hay·yām bay·yab·bā·šāh
verses.literal: And as for you lift up your staff and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it so that the Israelites . . . can go through the sea on dry ground
verses.literalPt: E tu, levanta a tua vara, estende a mão sobre o mar e divide-o, para que os filhos de Israel caminhem pelo meio do mar em seco.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י הִנְנִ֤י מְחַזֵּק֙ אֶת־ לֵ֣ב מִצְרַ֔יִם וְיָבֹ֖אוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וְאִכָּבְדָ֤ה בְּפַרְעֹה֙ וּבְכָל־ חֵיל֔וֹ בְּרִכְבּ֖וֹ וּבְפָרָשָֽׁיו׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî hin·nî mə·ḥaz·zêq ’eṯ- lêḇ miṣ·ra·yim wə·yā·ḇō·’ū ’a·ḥă·rê·hem wə·’ik·kā·ḇə·ḏāh bə·p̄ar·‘ōh ū·ḇə·ḵāl ḥê·lōw bə·riḵ·bōw ū·ḇə·p̄ā·rā·šāw
verses.literal: And I . . . will harden the hearts of the Egyptians so that they will go in after them Then I will gain honor by means of Pharaoh and all his army and chariots and horsemen
verses.literalPt: Eis que eu hei de endurecer os corações dos egípcios, e entrarão atrás deles; glorificar-me-ei em Faraó e em todo o seu exército, nos seus carros e nos seus cavaleiros.

verses.original: וְיָדְע֥וּ מִצְרַ֖יִם כִּי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּהִכָּבְדִ֣י בְּפַרְעֹ֔ה בְּרִכְבּ֖וֹ וּבְפָרָשָֽׁיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū miṣ·ra·yim kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh bə·hik·kā·ḇə·ḏî bə·p̄ar·‘ōh bə·riḵ·bōw ū·ḇə·p̄ā·rā·šāw
verses.literal: The Egyptians will know that I am the LORD when I am honored through Pharaoh his chariots and his horsemen
verses.literalPt: Os egípcios saberão que eu sou Jeová, quando me tiver glorificado em Faraó, nos seus carros e nos seus cavaleiros.

verses.original: וַיִּסַּ֞ע מַלְאַ֣ךְ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים הַהֹלֵךְ֙ לִפְנֵי֙ מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּסַּ֞ע עַמּ֤וּד הֶֽעָנָן֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיַּֽעֲמֹ֖ד מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·sa‘ mal·’aḵ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ha·hō·lêḵ lip̄·nê ma·ḥă·nêh yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·leḵ mê·’a·ḥă·rê·hem way·yis·sa‘ ‘am·mūḏ he·‘ā·nān mip·pə·nê·hem way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ mê·’a·ḥă·rê·hem
verses.literal: And the angel of God who had gone before the camp of Israel withdrew and went behind them The pillar of cloud also moved from before them and stood behind them
verses.literalPt: Então, o Anjo de Deus, que ia adiante do campo de Israel, se retirou e ia atrás deles; a coluna de nuvem retirou-se de diante deles, e pôs-se atrás deles,

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֞א בֵּ֣ין׀ מַחֲנֵ֣ה מִצְרַ֗יִם וּבֵין֙ מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיְהִ֤י הֶֽעָנָן֙ וְהַחֹ֔שֶׁךְ וַיָּ֖אֶר אֶת־ הַלָּ֑יְלָה וְלֹא־ קָרַ֥ב זֶ֛ה אֶל־ זֶ֖ה כָּל־ הַלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō bên ma·ḥă·nêh miṣ·ra·yim ū·ḇên ma·ḥă·nêh yiś·rā·’êl way·hî he·‘ā·nān wə·ha·ḥō·šeḵ way·yā·’er ’eṯ- hal·lā·yə·lāh wə·lō- qā·raḇ zeh ’el- zeh kāl- hal·lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: so that it came between the camps of Egypt and . . . Israel The cloud was there in the darkness but it lit up the night So all night long neither camp went near the other . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: e veio entre o campo do Egito e o campo de Israel. Havia a nuvem e as trevas; contudo, brilhava de noite. Toda a noite não se aproximou um do outro.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨ט מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶת־ יָדוֹ֮ עַל־ הַיָּם֒ וַיּ֣וֹלֶךְ יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֶת־ הַ֠יָּם בְּר֨וּחַ קָדִ֤ים עַזָּה֙ כָּל־ הַלַּ֔יְלָה וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם לֶחָרָבָ֑ה וַיִּבָּקְע֖וּ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yêṭ mō·šeh ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw ‘al- hay·yām way·yō·w·leḵ Yah·weh ’eṯ- hay·yām bə·rū·aḥ qā·ḏîm ‘az·zāh kāl- hal·lay·lāh way·yā·śem ’eṯ- hay·yām le·ḥā·rā·ḇāh way·yib·bā·qə·‘ū ham·mā·yim
verses.literal: Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea and all that night the LORD drove back the sea with a strong east wind that turned it into dry land So the waters were divided
verses.literalPt: Então, Moisés estendeu a mão sobre o mar. Jeová fez retirar-se o mar por um forte vento oriental toda a noite e fez do mar terra seca, e as águas foram divididas.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיָּ֖ם בַּיַּבָּשָׁ֑ה וְהַמַּ֤יִם לָהֶם֙ חֹמָ֔ה מִֽימִינָ֖ם וּמִשְּׂמֹאלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·ṯō·wḵ hay·yām bay·yab·bā·šāh wə·ham·ma·yim lā·hem ḥō·māh mî·mî·nām ū·miś·śə·mō·lām
verses.literal: and the Israelites . . . went through the sea on dry ground with walls of water on their right and on their left
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Israel entraram no meio do mar em seco; e as águas foram-lhes como um muro à direita e à esquerda.

verses.original: וַיִּרְדְּפ֤וּ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֚ל ס֣וּס פַּרְעֹ֔ה רִכְבּ֖וֹ וּפָרָשָׁ֑יו אֶל־ תּ֖וֹךְ הַיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·də·p̄ū miṣ·ra·yim way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’a·ḥă·rê·hem kōl sūs par·‘ōh riḵ·bōw ū·p̄ā·rā·šāw ’el- tō·wḵ hay·yām
verses.literal: And the Egyptians chased after them all Pharaoh’s horses chariots and horsemen and followed them into . . . the sea
verses.literalPt: Os egípcios perseguiram e entraram atrás deles no meio do mar, todos os cavalos de Faraó, os seus carros e os seus cavaleiros.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בְּאַשְׁמֹ֣רֶת הַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיַּשְׁקֵ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מַחֲנֵ֣ה מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּעַמּ֥וּד אֵ֖שׁ וְעָנָ֑ן וַיָּ֕הָם אֵ֖ת מַחֲנֵ֥ה מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·’aš·mō·reṯ hab·bō·qer way·yaš·qêp̄ Yah·weh ’el- ma·ḥă·nêh miṣ·ra·yim bə·‘am·mūḏ ’êš wə·‘ā·nān way·yā·hām ’êṯ ma·ḥă·nêh miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: At morning watch however the LORD looked down on the army of the Egyptians from the pillar of fire and cloud and He threw their camp into confusion - . . .
verses.literalPt: Na vigília da manhã, olhou Jeová para o exército dos egípcios, por entre a coluna de fogo e de nuvem, e alvorotou o exército dos egípcios.

verses.original: וַיָּ֗סַר אֵ֚ת אֹפַ֣ן מַרְכְּבֹתָ֔יו וַֽיְנַהֲגֵ֖הוּ בִּכְבֵדֻ֑ת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מִצְרַ֗יִם אָנ֙וּסָה֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה נִלְחָ֥ם לָהֶ֖ם בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·sar ’êṯ ’ō·p̄an mar·kə·ḇō·ṯāw way·na·hă·ḡê·hū biḵ·ḇê·ḏuṯ way·yō·mer miṣ·ra·yim ’ā·nū·sāh mip·pə·nê yiś·rā·’êl kî Yah·weh nil·ḥām lā·hem bə·miṣ·rå̄·yim
verses.literal: He caused their chariot wheels to wobble so that they had difficulty driving Let us flee from the Israelites said the Egyptians for the LORD is fighting for them against Egypt
verses.literalPt: Tirou-lhes as rodas dos carros e fê-los andar dificultosamente; de modo que os egípcios disseram: Fujamos de diante de Israel, porque Jeová está pelejando por eles contra os egípcios.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה נְטֵ֥ה אֶת־ יָדְךָ֖ עַל־ הַיָּ֑ם וְיָשֻׁ֤בוּ הַמַּ֙יִם֙ עַל־ מִצְרַ֔יִם עַל־ רִכְבּ֖וֹ וְעַל־ פָּרָשָֽׁיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh nə·ṭêh ’eṯ- yā·ḏə·ḵā ‘al- hay·yām wə·yā·šu·ḇū ham·ma·yim ‘al- miṣ·ra·yim ‘al- riḵ·bōw wə·‘al- pā·rā·šāw
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Stretch out your hand over the sea so that the waters may flow back over the Egyptians and their chariots . . . and horsemen
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Estende a mão sobre o mar, para que se voltem as águas sobre os egípcios, sobre os seus carros e sobre os seus cavaleiros.

verses.original: וַיֵּט֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה אֶת־ יָד֜וֹ עַל־ הַיָּ֗ם וַיָּ֨שָׁב הַיָּ֜ם לִפְנ֥וֹת בֹּ֙קֶר֙ לְאֵ֣יתָנ֔וֹ וּמִצְרַ֖יִם נָסִ֣ים לִקְרָאת֑וֹ וַיְנַעֵ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מִצְרַ֖יִם בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yêṭ mō·šeh ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw ‘al- hay·yām way·yā·šāḇ hay·yām lip̄·nō·wṯ bō·qer lə·’ê·ṯā·nōw ū·miṣ·ra·yim nā·sîm liq·rā·ṯōw way·na·‘êr Yah·weh ’eṯ- miṣ·ra·yim bə·ṯō·wḵ hay·yām
verses.literal: So Moses stretched out his hand over the sea and at daybreak . . . the sea returned to its normal state As the Egyptians were retreating the LORD - swept them into the sea
verses.literalPt: Moisés estendeu a mão sobre o mar, e o mar, ao romper da manhã, voltou à sua força; os egípcios fugiram de encontro a ele, e Jeová derribou os egípcios no meio do mar.

verses.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֣בוּ הַמַּ֗יִם וַיְכַסּ֤וּ אֶת־ הָרֶ֙כֶב֙ וְאֶת־ הַפָּ֣רָשִׁ֔ים לְכֹל֙ חֵ֣יל פַּרְעֹ֔ה הַבָּאִ֥ים אַחֲרֵיהֶ֖ם בַּיָּ֑ם לֹֽא־ נִשְׁאַ֥ר בָּהֶ֖ם עַד־ אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šu·ḇū ham·ma·yim way·ḵas·sū ’eṯ- hā·re·ḵeḇ wə·’eṯ- hap·pā·rā·šîm lə·ḵōl ḥêl par·‘ōh hab·bā·’îm ’a·ḥă·rê·hem bay·yām lō- niš·’ar bā·hem ‘aḏ- ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: The waters flowed back and covered the chariots and horsemen the entire army of Pharaoh that had chased the Israelites into the sea Not one of them survived . . .
verses.literalPt: As águas voltaram a cobrir os carros e os cavaleiros, sim todo o exército de Faraó que atrás deles entrou no mar; deles não ficou nem sequer um.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הָלְכ֥וּ בַיַּבָּשָׁ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ הַיָּ֑ם וְהַמַּ֤יִם לָהֶם֙ חֹמָ֔ה מִֽימִינָ֖ם וּמִשְּׂמֹאלָֽם
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hā·lə·ḵū ḇay·yab·bā·šāh bə·ṯō·wḵ hay·yām wə·ham·ma·yim lā·hem ḥō·māh mî·mî·nām ū·miś·śə·mō·lå̄m
verses.literal: But the Israelites . . . had walked through the sea on dry ground with walls of water on their right and on their left
verses.literalPt: Porém os filhos de Israel caminhavam a pé enxuto no meio do mar; e as águas foram-lhes como um muro à direita e à esquerda.

verses.original: וַיּ֨וֹשַׁע יְהוָ֜ה בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֛וּא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִיַּ֣ד מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיַּ֤רְא יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־ מִצְרַ֔יִם מֵ֖ת עַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת הַיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·wō·ša‘ Yah·weh bay·yō·wm ha·hū ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl mî·yaḏ miṣ·rā·yim way·yar yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- miṣ·ra·yim mêṯ ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ hay·yām
verses.literal: That day the LORD saved Israel from the hand of the Egyptians and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the shore . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim Jeová salvou a Israel naquele dia da mão dos egípcios; e Israel viu os egípcios mortos na praia do mar.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨רְא יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־ הַיָּ֣ד הַגְּדֹלָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּֽירְא֥וּ הָעָ֖ם אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּֽאֲמִ֙ינוּ֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה וּבְמֹשֶׁ֖ה עַבְדּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yar yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- hay·yāḏ hag·gə·ḏō·lāh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh bə·miṣ·ra·yim way·yî·rə·’ū hā·‘ām ’eṯ- Yah·weh way·ya·’ă·mî·nū Yah·weh ū·ḇə·mō·šeh ‘aḇ·dōw
verses.literal: When Israel saw the great power that the LORD had exercised over the Egyptians the people feared the LORD and believed in Him and in His servant Moses
verses.literalPt: Viu Israel o grande poder que Jeová exercitou contra os egípcios, e o povo temeu a Jeová; creram em Jeová e em seu servo Moisés.
